problem_statement: Oversized CoAP request payloads are silently truncated to the configured maximum chunk size and delivered to a resource handler as if complete. Requests exceeding that limit must instead receive a 4.13 Request Entity Too Large response advertising the supported payload size in Size1, so the sender can retry using blockwise transfer. The resource handler must not receive such requests. Preserve request correlation for confirmable and non-confirmable messages, normal requests at the size limit, malformed-message error behavior, and the existing truncation behavior for oversized response payloads.
